verdict.rationale: Missive documents connecting Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, and IMAP accounts, IMAP/SMTP server connections, and full two-way Gmail sync. That means mail stays on the user's standard-protocol mail server, where other clients can still reach it. Missive does not itself serve IMAP/JMAP access or offer a standards-based export, so the evidence covers only part of the anti-lock-in story. Missing for 10: standards-based export (mbox/EML), any JMAP support, protocol access to Missive-native data (team chats, comments, shared drafts), and independent hands-on corroboration that mail stays fully portable.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
